integration_issues.issue: When user opens /checkout directly (F5 / paste URL) with a valid token in localStorage, Checkout.jsx useEffect fires before AuthContext.fetchMe() resolves (user is null while loading=true), causing an immediate redirect to '/' with the Sign-In modal. Works fine via SPA cart-checkout-btn click. Fix: guard with `if (!loading && !user)` in Checkout.jsx.

action_items: Minor: In /app/frontend/src/pages/Checkout.jsx line 34-36, change guard to `if (!loading && !user)` and also import `loading` from useAuth — avoids redirect race when user opens /checkout directly.
Optional: Confirm men-side category images (gdacz180 = Men's Hair Coloring; a9rwtded = Men's Korean Combo) render when user switches to Men gender tab — code URLs are correct.
critical_code_review_comments: Cart backend /api/cart/add uses $push unconditionally (server allows duplicates). Frontend CartContext.addItem() has a client-side dedup check, but if two rapid clicks both pass the check before setItems commits, race is theoretically possible. Consider server-side dedup ($addToSet or checking existence before push) as defense-in-depth.
Checkout auth guard should respect `loading` state (see integration issue above) to prevent redirect race for direct URL access.

rca of the issue: Original double-add bug in Bridal was because BridalSection's Add button called BOTH onAdd(s) (which invokes addItem via Home.jsx) AND addItem(s) directly. Fix removed the redundant direct call; button now only calls onAdd(s). Verified: single click -> exactly 1 item in /api/cart response.
